description: Ministry of Investment Promotion - The Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act. No 11 of 2021 " GTN GROUP HOLDING LIMITED "
categorisation: This gazette notification contains an order made under Section 53 of the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act, No. 11 of 2021, which establishes a legal/regulatory framework. The content specifies exemptions and incentives granted under various enactments (Inland Revenue Act, Value Added Tax Act, Finance Acts, etc.), making it primarily about regulatory matters and legal provisions rather than government personnel/structure, land, commercial registrations, or other specialized categories.
